ex.en: Volunteers stood at the station to distribute tracts about the new health policy.
ex.zh: 志愿者站在车站，发放介绍新医疗政策的传单。

words.note: tract 指大片土地或宣传小册子；a tract of land 是一片土地。

ex.en: You can change the configuration of the screen in the settings menu.
ex.zh: 你可以在设置菜单中更改屏幕的配置。

words.note: configure 是动词，configuration 指配置、布局。

ex.en: The nurse shook the mercury thermometer before taking my temperature.
ex.zh: 护士甩了甩水银温度计，然后给我量体温。

words.note: mercury 意为水银，化学符号 Hg；大写指水星。

ex.en: Her frequent visits to the library helped her improve her reading skills.
ex.zh: 她经常去图书馆，这帮助她提高了阅读能力。

words.note: frequent 作形容词重音在前，作动词意为“常去”。

ex.en: He cut the meat into small chunks and added them to the soup.
ex.zh: 他把肉切成小块，放进汤里。

words.note: chunk 指厚块、大块；a chunk of time 表一大段时间。

ex.en: Children learn social skills when they interact with others in group games.
ex.zh: 孩子们在集体游戏中与他人互动时学习社交技能。

words.note: interact with sb 是固定搭配；名词为 interaction。

ex.en: Smartphones have become commonplace among students in just a few years.
ex.zh: 短短几年间，智能手机在学生中已变得很普遍。

words.note: commonplace 表“司空见惯的”，比 common 更强调不稀奇。

ex.en: In aggregate, the company's sales rose by five percent last year.
ex.zh: 总体来看，公司去年的销售额增长了百分之五。

words.note: aggregate 作名词读 /ˈæɡrɪɡət/，作动词读 /ˈæɡrɪɡeɪt/。

ex.en: The seemingly simple task took the whole team three days to finish.
ex.zh: 这项看似简单的任务花了整个团队三天才完成。

words.note: seemingly 意为“看似”，常用于 seemingly endless 等搭配。

ex.en: The flight attendant asked all passengers to fasten their seat belts.
ex.zh: 空乘人员请所有乘客系好安全带。

words.note: attendant 作形容词表“伴随的”，常修饰 problems、risks。

ex.en: The store offers a wide array of fresh fruit and vegetables.
ex.zh: 这家店供应各种各样的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

words.note: an array of 后接可数名词复数，表“大量、一系列”。

ex.en: Engineers adjusted several parameters to make the engine run more smoothly.
ex.zh: 工程师调整了几个参数，让发动机运行得更平稳。

words.note: parameter 多用于技术语境指参数，也指界限、范围。

ex.en: Many species will become extinct if their habitats are destroyed.
ex.zh: 如果栖息地被破坏，许多物种将会灭绝。

words.note: extinct 指物种已灭绝或火山已死；名词是 extinction。

ex.en: It is illegal for employers to discriminate against workers because of age.
ex.zh: 雇主因年龄歧视员工是违法的。

words.note: discriminate 后接 against 表歧视，接 between 表区分。

ex.en: Heavy grazing can degrade the soil within a few years.
ex.zh: 过度放牧会在几年内使土壤退化。

words.note: degrade 指使退化、有辱人格；名词是 degradation。

ex.en: The bathroom window is made of opaque glass so nobody can see in.
ex.zh: 浴室窗户用的是不透明玻璃，没人能看进来。

words.note: opaque 本指不透明，引申指文字、说法晦涩难懂。

ex.en: She worked two jobs to repay the loan she took for college.
ex.zh: 她打两份工来偿还上大学时借的贷款。

words.note: repay 可接钱或人；repay sb for sth 表示为某事报答。

ex.en: The central bank tightened monetary policy to control rising prices.
ex.zh: 央行收紧货币政策以控制物价上涨。

words.note: monetary 来自 money，常搭配 policy、value、system。

ex.en: Leaving the gas on was a grave mistake that could have killed us.
ex.zh: 没关煤气是个严重错误，可能让我们丧命。

words.note: grave 作形容词表“严重的”，比 serious 更书面；作名词是坟墓。

ex.en: Students should take advantage of the library before the exam week.
ex.zh: 学生应趁考试周前好好利用图书馆。

words.note: take advantage of 可指利用，也可指占某人便宜。

ex.en: The new tax plan sparked a heated controversy across the country.
ex.zh: 新税收方案在全国引发了激烈争论。

words.note: controversy 常接 over/about，形容词 controversial。

ex.en: A good teacher can command respect without raising his voice.
ex.zh: 好老师不用提高声音也能赢得尊重。

words.note: command respect 是固定搭配，表赢得尊重。

ex.en: Nine years of compulsory education is free for every child in the country.
ex.zh: 全国每个孩子都享有九年免费义务教育。

words.note: compulsory 指规定必须做的；选修课是 optional course。

ex.en: The band gave a live performance in the park on Saturday evening.
ex.zh: 周六晚上乐队在公园进行了现场演出。

words.note: performance 可指演出，也可指工作表现和机器性能。

ex.en: The shop checks the serial numbers of every camera it repairs.
ex.zh: 这家店会核对每台维修相机的序列号。

words.note: serial 强调连续编号或连载；a TV serial 指连续剧。

ex.en: Organizers anticipate a large crowd at the concert this weekend.
ex.zh: 主办方预计本周末的音乐会将有大量观众。

words.note: anticipate 后可接名词或动名词，不接 to do。

ex.en: You can detach the keyboard from the tablet and use it alone.
ex.zh: 你可以把键盘从平板上拆下来单独使用。

words.note: detach 表拆下、分开，反义词是 attach。

ex.en: The company had to slash its budget after sales fell sharply.
ex.zh: 销量骤降后，公司只得大幅削减预算。

words.note: slash 表大幅削减，比 cut 语气更强；也指斜线号。

ex.en: He was accused of trying to fabricate evidence for the trial.
ex.zh: 他被指控试图为审判伪造证据。

words.note: fabricate 原指制造，现多指编造、伪造。

ex.en: My brother spends his weekends reading comic books and playing games.
ex.zh: 我弟弟周末都在看漫画和打游戏。

words.note: comic 作名词指漫画；作形容词指滑稽的。
